# Torch constraint for CUDA 13.x drivers (driver >= 580).
# See constraints-cu124.txt for the full rationale. On a CUDA-13 driver the
# default PyPI torch wheel is already a cu13x build, so this file mainly pins a
# known-good, reproducible version rather than fixing a mismatch.
#
#     pip install "torch>=2.0,<3" --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130
#     pip install -e ".[local]" -c constraints-cu130.txt

--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130

torch==2.9.0+cu130
torchvision==0.24.0+cu130
torchaudio==2.9.0+cu130
